text: A consequence of the PBW theorem is that the natural map $\mathfrak{g} \to \mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g})$ is injective.
explanation: True: PBW exhibits an explicit basis in which the degree-one elements form a basis of $\mathfrak{g}$, so they stay linearly independent inside $\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g})$. Hence $\mathfrak{g}$ embeds as a Lie subalgebra of its universal enveloping algebra.
